description: Presidential Secretartiate - An Essential Public Service to the life of Community - 1. All Services Connected to the Supply of Electricity. 2. The Supply or Distribution of Petroleum Products and Fuel.
categorisation: This gazette content is a presidential order declaring certain services as essential public services under the Essential Public Services Act, No. 61 of 1979. It establishes a legal/regulatory framework by exercising statutory powers to declare electricity supply and petroleum distribution as essential services, making it a legal/regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change.
